lines.text: وقت نماز بامداد وقتی بود که افتاب طلوع میکند و فضیلت وقت نزد فرقه ناجیه امامیه
lines.en: The time for the morning prayer is when the sun rises, and the merit of the time according to the saved sect of the Imamiyyah

lines.text: از اول طلوعست تا ظهور سرخی از جانب مشرق اما افضل در ادای صلوة یومیه اول وقت
lines.en: is from the beginning of sunrise until the appearance of redness from the east. However, the most excellent in performing the daily prayer is the beginning of the time,

lines.text: است لقوله علیه السلام اول الوقت رضوان الله و اخر الوقت غفران الله و اول وقت
lines.en: according to his saying, peace be upon him: 'The beginning of the time is the pleasure of God, and the end of the time is the forgiveness of God.' And the beginning of the time

lines.text: نماز پیشین باتفاق جمیع فرق انجاست که ابتداء زیاده شدن ظل مقیاس باشد بر
lines.en: for the noon prayer, by the agreement of all sects, is when the shadow of the gnomon begins to increase over

lines.text: فی زوالی اگر در انروز موجود باشد یا ابتداء حدوث ظل اگر در انروز فی زوال موجود
lines.en: the shadow of noon, if it exists on that day, or the beginning of the occurrence of the shadow, if the shadow of noon exists on that day.

lines.text: باشد و این در موضعی صورت بندد که افتاب بسمت الراس الموضع تواند رسید و
lines.en: And this takes place in a location where the sun can reach the zenith of the location, and

lines.text: اول وقت نماز دیگر انگاه است که ظل مقیاس دو برابر شود سوای فی زوال یعنی
lines.en: the beginning of the time for the other prayer is when the shadow of the gnomon becomes twice as long, excluding the shadow of noon, meaning

lines.text: وقتیکه ظل مقیاس مساوی مجموع وضعف مقیاس و فی زوال شود اگر فی زوال
lines.en: when the shadow of the gnomon equals the sum of twice the gnomon and the shadow of noon, if the shadow of noon

lines.text: موجود باشد یا وقتیکه مساوی ضعف مقیاس شود پس اگر موجود نباشد و این بروایتی
lines.en: exists, or when it equals twice the gnomon. So if it does not exist, and this is according to a narration

lines.text: از مذهب ابو حنیفه است و بر مذهب شافعی و همچنین بر مذهب ابو یوسف و محمد که از
lines.en: from the school of Abu Hanifa, and according to the school of Shafi'i, and also according to the school of Abu Yusuf and Muhammad, who are from

lines.text: ملاحظه ابو حنیفه اند و بروایتی بر مذهب ابو حنیفه اول وقت نماز دیگر انوقت باشد که
lines.en: the followers of Abu Hanifa. And according to a narration on the school of Abu Hanifa, the beginning of the time for the other prayer is when

lines.text: ظل مقیاس برابر مقیاس شود سواء فی زوال اما بمذهب قوم امامیه علیهم التحیة و
lines.en: the shadow of the gnomon equals the gnomon, excluding the shadow of noon. However, according to the school of the Imamiyyah people, upon them be greetings and

lines.text: الثناء که بر این صراط مستقیم است از ابتداء زوال مخصوص وقت پیشینی است تا
lines.en: praise, who are on this straight path, from the beginning of noon is specifically the time for the noon prayer until

lines.text: انمقدار که فرض انگذارده شود بعد از ان اول عصر در اید و در انحال هر دو وقت
lines.en: that amount [of time] in which its obligation is performed. After that, the beginning of the afternoon prayer enters, and in that state, both times

lines.text: مشترک بود تا انزمان که بغروب مقدار ادای صلوة فریضه عصر باقی ماند و بعد از ان
lines.en: are shared until the time when the amount for performing the obligatory afternoon prayer remains before sunset, and after that

lines.text: تا غروب مخصوص نماز عصر باشد کما قال الامام الحاذق جعفر ابن محمد الصادق علیه الصلوة
lines.en: until sunset is specifically for the afternoon prayer, as the skillful Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq, upon him be prayers

lines.text: والسلام اذا زالت الشمس دخل وقت الظهر فاذا مضى قدر اربع رکعات دخلت وقت
lines.en: and peace, said: 'When the sun declines, the time for noon prayer enters, and when the amount of four rak'ahs passes, the time enters

lines.text: الظهر والعصر حتى يبقى من تغرب الشمس قدر اربع رکعات فيخرج وقت الظهر و يبقى العصر حتى تغرب
lines.en: for noon and afternoon until the amount of four rak'ahs remains before the sun sets, then the time for noon exits and the afternoon remains until it sets.'

lines.text: الشمس واخر وقت عصر باتفاق جمیع فرقه وقتیست که افتاب غروب میکند اما فضیلت وقت
lines.en: The sun. And the end of the time for the afternoon prayer, by the agreement of all sects, is when the sun sets. However, the merit of the time

summary.headline: Prayer Times and Gnomon Shadows
summary.text: Discussion of the canonical times for morning, noon, and afternoon prayers, calculated by sunrise, sunset, the sun’s zenith, and the gnomon’s shadow. It compares Imamiyyah rulings with the schools of Abu Hanifa and al-Shafi‘i and cites Ja‘far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq on the shared noon-afternoon interval and four-rak‘ah limits.
